anchor_check.method: Each frame viewed whole at 720x1280, then ffmpeg crops of the 1440x2560 png: faces beside the sheet's front close-up (and kiran_p1's three-quarter view), Mausi's nostril (3x nearest), Billu's eyes (2x), hands and fingers, cuffs, henna, keys, phones, the toothpick, Aditya's chest and wrists, the hasp and padlock, the bag and chair, the tray on the stool, the car's rear and plates, shutters and the boys' clothing, and a 20 px grid over the s27 heads for height. Each png is an exact lanczos upscale of its 941x1672 raw (PSNR inf for all four), so detail is the raw's. Judged against shots.json (shot state, framing, refs, screen_direction, state_ledger, generation_gates), the four prompts (read in full), style.json locks as copied into the prompts' CHARACTER LOCK, decisions D-013, D-015, D-017, D-021, D-023, and refs kiran_p1, aditya, billu, mausi, pair_kiran_mausi_p1, bedroom_bed, bedroom_door, lane_night, billu_car, stairwell_up. Subtitle band positions read from production/remotion/src/Episode.tsx (burn-in: box bottom at 81 % of frame height, top at 73-76 %) and app/src/styles/bundle.css (.uw-stage-bottom, bottom 18 px).

editor_notes: s01: the lit phone sits at about 78-85 % of the frame height and her fingertips at about 77-79 % (eye readings from 720x1280 x2); the prompt asked for about 62 %. The push-in (0.3, focus 0.6/0.33) drives it lower, to about 84-91 % at the end. In the app (subtitles at the bottom of the stage) the top of the phone and the glow stay visible; under the Remotion burn-in box (73-81 %) the hand and the top of the phone would be covered. Prefer a hold, or a custom move at scale 1.08 or less that looks slightly further down, so the glow stays clear of the subtitle plate on l01/l02.

s27: Kiran's palms and cuffs sit at about 70-79 % (prompt: 55-62 %), just above the bottom fifth. The push-in (0.25, focus 0.5/0.35) moves the fingertips to about 82 %. Prefer a hold or a focus near y 0.7 so the palms stay above the subtitle plate on l20.

Light direction judged by eye.
Text: by eye on whole frames and on crops of the phone screen, the car rear, the shutters, the boys' clothing and the door hardware; not every part of every frame was cropped.
